legal_units.title: Unexplained investment.
legal_units.text: Where in any tax year, any investment has been made by the assessee which is not recorded in the books of account, if any, maintained by such assessee for any source of income, or, the Assessing Officer finds that the amount of such investment exceeds the amount recorded in such books of account and— then, the value of such investment, or such excess amount, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be the income of the assessee of that tax year.
